summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude compensation received for inactive-duty military training from gross income, making it tax-exempt.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude inactive-duty training compensation from gross income, which would result in lower taxes for military personnel receiving such compensation. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

By reducing the tax base through an exclusion from gross income, this bill would lead to a decrease in federal revenue, which could contribute to a larger national debt if not offset. While not the primary focus, it has a direct fiscal implication.
